entries.title: I Thessalonians 2:6
segments: Authority. Paul led his converts into the truth, he did not exercise lordship over them.  See

entries.title: I Thessalonians 2:9
segments: Might not burden any. One of the arguments used against Paul by his critics was the fact that he did not ask maintenance of those to whom he ministered, according to the declaration of the Lord, that 'the laborer is worthy of his hire' (
).  At Thessalonica he worked 'night and day' to maintain himself.  See

entries.title: I Thessalonians 2:15
segments: Drove out us. The Jews were particularly bitter against Paul because of his ministering to the Gentiles. See
.  Even the Christian Jews followed him from place to place declaiming against him and his work.  See

entries.title: I Thessalonians 2:18
segments: Satan hindered. It is surmised that illness prevented Paul's going to Thessalonica.  See
